catalogMetricsByHostLms.no_results: No catalog metrics found. Try changing your search terms or filters.

brand.theme_help: Chosen from the themes the discovery app ships. Every one has been checked for color contrast in light, dark and high-contrast modes.

explainer.re_resolution: When enabled, re-resolution will be active for this consortium. This means that if the chosen supplier cannot fulfill a request, OpenRS DCB automatically looks for another supplier instead of failing the request.

verification.ingest_timeout_advice: DCB stops waiting after 20 seconds. For a large catalog the harvest often succeeds shortly afterwards, so check the library's Bib records page once setup is finished before treating this as a failure.

config_fields.services_organisation_id_description: Organization identifier used by application services.
config_fields.role_catalogue: Catalog: this system supplies the bibliographic records
config_fields.koha_harvesting_group_description: DCB harvests bib records from Koha's OPAC over OAI-PMH. In Koha, set the OAI-PMH system preference to Enable and give OAI-PMH:archiveID a value. Leave the OAI set blank to harvest the whole catalog.
config_fields.roles_description: Which DCB roles this system fulfills, e.g. CATALOGUE, CIRCULATION. Leave blank for the defaults.

group.subtitle: Requesting activity, fulfillment and value across this group's libraries.

consortium.subtitle: Requesting activity, fulfillment and value across the whole consortium.

library.subtitle: Requesting activity, fulfillment and value for this library.

collection.section_subtitle: The catalog as ingested, rather than the traffic over it. These figures count works held, not requests made, so the date range above does not apply to them.
collection.computing: Counting across the whole catalog. The first count can take several minutes, and this panel will check again on its own.

profile.subtitle: Works contributed to the shared catalog, and how many of them nobody else holds.

format_mix.title: Format mix of the catalog
format_mix.chart_label: Catalog format mix across {{count}} formats, largest is {{top}}.

transit_dwell_trend.not: It measures the status, not the courier: an item scanned late at the receiving end is indistinguishable from one that traveled slowly. A system that does not report the return leg contributes nothing to it rather than contributing a zero.

requests_fulfilled.how: The successful and failed counts from the borrower fulfillment query, added together. Successful means the request reached loaned, completed or finalized.

items_supplied.not: Local fulfillment is excluded: an item this library supplied to its own patron is not network traffic.

turnaround_to_finalise.how: Median and 95th percentile from request creation to the first audit entry reaching finalized.
turnaround_to_finalise.not: Finalization trails the patron's experience by a long way - the item has usually been back on the shelf for some time - so this is an operations figure, not a service one.

supplier_reliability.how: Per supplier, requests that reached loaned, completed or finalized against those that errored, were canceled, or found no selectable item.

trading_partners.how: Requests grouped by the partner at the other end, excluding errored requests and local fulfillment, because a failed request is not traffic and a local loan is not a partnership.

peer_benchmarks.not: It is deliberately not pseudonymized: members are named, because a benchmark nobody can act on is decoration.

cost_avoidance.what: What these fulfillments would have cost through traditional interlibrary loan.
cost_avoidance.how: Successful fulfillments in the window multiplied by a unit cost you supply. No cost is shipped with the product.

systems.patron_site_help: The library's own website, for a patron who needs opening hours or the reference desk.

dcb.description: $t(app.dcb) is an $t(openrs.name) product that enables libraries to deliver direct consortial borrowing services to their patrons across a range of LMS and discovery systems. <paragraph/> Developed by <linkComponent>$t(openrs.who.kint_full)</linkComponent>, $t(app.dcb) helps consortia fulfill patrons borrowing requests across their membership faster and cheaper than traditional resource sharing methods.<paragraph/>

patron_request.cleanup_successful: The cleanup operation has been successful, and the patron request has been finalized.
patron_request.confirm_returned_body: Do this once the item is back on the supplying library's shelf: the library has not reported it. The request is then released as if it had. A canceled request finishes as canceled, and a returned loan completes.

selection.automatic_context: DCB will automatically select an item to fulfill this request.
selection.manual_context: DCB will use the criteria provided to select an item to fulfill this request

confirmation.para1_disable_supplying: Catalog records for <bold>{{library}}</bold> will <bold>not be discoverable</bold> or <bold>requestable</bold> by patrons of other consortium libraries.
